documents.text: Marriott International, Inc. is an American multinational company that operates, franchises, and licenses lodging brands that include hotel, residential, and timeshare properties. The company owns over 37 hotel and timeshare brands, with 9,000 locations and 1,597,380 rooms across its network. Headquartered in Bethesda, Maryland, the company is the successor to the hospitality division of the Marriott Corporation, which was founded by J. Willard Marriott (1900–1985) and his wife Alice Marriott (1907–2000).

(/ˈmær.i.ət/)[4] is an American multinational company that operates, franchises, and licenses lodging brands that include hotel, residential, and timeshare properties.[2][3] The company owns over 37 hotel and timeshare brands, with 9,000 locations and 1,597,380 rooms across its network (as of 2023).[5] Headquartered in Bethesda, Maryland, the company is the successor to the hospitality division of the Marriott Corporation, which was founded by J. Willard Marriott (1900–1985) and his wife Alice Marriott (1907–2000).[6] Profile Marriott International hotels worldwide Marriott International is the largest hotel company in the world by the number of available rooms. It has 41 brands with 9,361 properties containing 1,706,331 rooms in 144 countries and territories according to 2025 financial documents.[2] Of these 9,361 properties, 1,981 are managed but not owned by Marriott, 7,192 are owned and managed by independent hospitality companies under franchise agreements with Marriott, and 51 are both owned and managed by Marriott.
